item.title: Essential Energy Power Outage Sat 12/12/2020 - edgefm.org.au
item.description: Essential Energy will be carrying out maintenance work that will cause a power outage to the studio on Saturday 12th December 2020 from 8:00 am to 2:00 pm. We apologise for this disruption to our broadcast. We will be back and broadcasting as soon as the work has been completed.
